images.actual_source_analysis: Observed source: one olive-green glazed ceramic electric kettle dominates the frame, with a rounded tapering body, domed green lid and oval knob, one short open spout pointing left, and a thick black loop handle on the right. The glaze has mottled fine speckling and bright vertical window reflections. The kettle rests on a beige patterned kitchen counter; a gray folded dishcloth lies behind-left. Further behind are a potted trailing plant at left, a white-and-blue utensil holder, wood chopping boards, a fruit bowl and a clear grain jar; a sink rim is partly visible at the lower-left corner. Preserve the kettle body proportions, lid/knob, left spout, right handle, base construction, color and glaze.
